name: Prone
effects: Movement halved (2 SQR per square).
+2 armor vs ranged attacks.
Melee attacks against you gain +4 TN.
clear: Spend 1 action to stand up.

name: Slowed
effects: −1 action on your next turn (minimum 1).
clear: Clears at the end of your next turn.

name: Stunned
effects: Next round you have only 1 action.
No proactive defense or opportunity attacks.
clear: Clears at the end of your next turn.

name: Blinded
effects: Automatically fail perception and line-of-sight checks.
Your attacks −10 TN or hit a random adjacent square.
Ranged attacks against you gain +4 TN.
clear: Clears at the end of your next turn (some abilities: longer), or spend 1 action to clear ocular feedback.

name: Broken arm
effects: One arm: only one one-handed weapon can be used (a hacker deck still works).
Both arms: only movement, talking and mental abilities.
clear: First aid (1 action, Medicine / First Aid check), a Basic Trauma Kit or Paramedic Case, or downtime.

name: Crippled leg
effects: One leg: half squares per move (rounded down, minimum 1).
Both legs: 1 square per move.
clear: First aid (1 action, Medicine / First Aid check), a Basic Trauma Kit or Paramedic Case, or downtime.

name: Disconnected
effects: Cut off from subnets, smart-link optics and HUD.
Hackers cannot run offensive payloads or keep sustained scripts.
Active sustained scripts end immediately.
clear: Computers / Hacking check (1 action) or a System Hard Reboot.

name: Jammed
effects: Weapon mount jammed: no attacks.
clear: 1 action to clear the jam (the unit or a technician).

name: Poisoned / Corroded
effects: Take 1d4 at the start of each turn.
Organic: bypasses armor, hits HP.
Synthetic: cracks 1 armor per round.
clear: Lasts 3 rounds, or Antitoxin / Burn Gel.

name: Enraged / Berserk
effects: Must spend all actions advancing on and attacking the nearest visible entity.
+2 melee damage; no cover or proactive defense.
clear: Ends after 2 rounds or with no targets in sight.

name: Incapacitated
effects: Unconscious or bricked: no actions, no defense.
Attacks hit automatically and can execute or amputate.
clear: Needs immediate stabilization: above 0 HP, a Paramedic Case, Adrenaline or Smelling Salts gets you up.

name: Wounded
effects: Has taken damage this combat. Smuggler pendulum drifts +1 at round end.
clear: Healed to full or end of combat.

name: Overdrive
effects: +1 action each round.
clear: Until the GM ends it (usually at the end of the scene).

name: Focused
effects: +2 TN on attacks.
clear: Until the GM ends it (usually at the end of the scene).

name: Unsteady
effects: −2 TN on attacks.
clear: At the end of the round.

name: Evasive
effects: Attacks against you at −2 TN.
clear: At the end of the round.

name: Sidestepping
effects: Attacks against you at −4 TN.
clear: At the end of the round.

name: Covered
effects: A teammate covers you: attacks against you at −2 TN.
clear: At the end of the round.

name: Sharp
effects: +1 TN on skill checks.
clear: Until the GM ends it (usually at the end of the scene).

name: Fired Up
effects: +1 OFF: every hit you land deals +1 damage.
clear: Until the GM ends it (usually at the end of the scene).

name: Guarded
effects: +2 TN on Dodge (Avoid / Reflexes).
clear: Until the GM ends it (usually at the end of the scene).

name: Bolstered
effects: +1 armor against every hit.
clear: Until the GM ends it (usually at the end of the scene).

name: Masked
targets: Operators wearing an ID Scramble Kit
effects: No visual ID possible: cameras, witnesses and face recognition cannot tell who you are.
Gloves: no fingerprints or DNA left behind.
But you are obviously masked: anyone who sees you treats you as hostile.
clear: Take the kit off (Gear).

name: Unreadable
targets: Operators wearing an enhanced ID Scramble Kit
effects: No ID possible: visual, thermal, gait and bone-structure scans are unreliable.
Gloves: no fingerprints or DNA left behind.
Monitoring alert: automated security flags you on sight — expect alarms.
clear: Take the kit off (Gear).

name: Braced
effects: +2 armor.
clear: Until your next turn, or what the ability says.

name: Suppressed
effects: −4 TN on attacks.
clear: When the ability says (most: the end of next round, or its next attack).

name: Marked
effects: Allies get +2 TN on attacks against it.
clear: At the end of the round.

name: Exposed
effects: The next hit against it ignores 2 armor.
clear: After that hit.
